transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been way more driven and wired than usual for weeks, like I can’t slow down or stop starting new projects. Now, it's really starting to blow up my job, which is why I'm here.
Have you also experienced an increased sense of self-importance or grandiosity along with this increased energy and drive?

Yeah, I absolutely have. I feel like I've been chosen for this special mission to completely transform and save the Providence waterfront economy. I've felt on top of the world, like I'm the only person who can actually pull this off.
Have you experienced any depressive episodes in the past, or has your mood been consistently elevated or irritable during this period of increased energy and drive?

During this high-energy time, my mood is either insanely pumped up like everyone else is in slow motion, or I flip on a dime and snap at people over nothing. At the same time, I've had these really heavy, guilty, and checked-out depressive feelings hanging over me for about the last four months as my job started to unravel.
Can you tell me more about the sequence of your mood shifts, specifically whether the depressive feelings started before, after, or at the same time as the high-energy periods?

The high-energy, wired phase definitely started first, right after I got my promotion and was buzzing with all these big ideas. The heavy, guilty, and depressed feelings set in later—about four months ago—once things at work actually started to fall apart and get messy.

Can you clarify if the depressive episodes and the high-energy periods have occurred at the same time, or have you experienced distinct periods where you're either highly energized and grandiose or depressed and guilty, with minimal overlap between the two states?

Actually, they seem to overlap and happen at the exact same time. Even when I'm running around with intense energy and big plans, I simultaneously feel this deep, heavy, worn-out feeling underneath it all, along with the guilt and dark thoughts. It's not like they are completely separate periods—it feels like I'm dealing with both at once.

Can you estimate how often you experience these overlapping periods of high energy and depressive feelings, and do you have any periods where you feel relatively normal, without either extreme, in between these episodes?

This is actually my first major, severe episode, which all started after my promotion, with the high-energy feelings kicking off first and the heavy, depressive feelings lasting for the last four months. Before this whole situation began, I had calmer stretches where I felt relatively normal and didn't experience either of these extreme highs or lows.

Can you tell me more about how long these episodes of high energy and depressive feelings have been lasting, and have you noticed any pattern or trigger that seems to bring them on or make them worse?

The overall cycle of high energy and crashing lows started about a month after I got promoted to my new regional account, with the heavy, depressed feelings lasting for about the last four months as my job fell apart. The main triggers were definitely the intense pressure from that promotion, aggressive sales targets, constant travel, and letting my sleep completely slide while pushing myself nonstop.

Can you confirm if the high-energy periods and depressive episodes have occurred in distinct episodes, or have they been intermixed throughout the entire duration, and are you currently experiencing more of the high-energy or depressive symptoms?

They are definitely heavily intermixed; even while I'm running on high gear and feeling wired, I've felt this deep, worn-out heaviness and guilt underneath it for the last four months. Right now, I'm experiencing a mix of both where I still feel buzzed and my mind is racing, but I'm also extremely crashed, overwhelmed by guilt, and having thoughts of not wanting to wake up.
Can you specify if you have had more than one distinct episode of these high-energy periods followed by depressive episodes, or is this your first major episode with intermixed symptoms?

Yes, this is definitely my very first major episode like this. Before my promotion and all the stress at work started, I had never experienced these kinds of extreme highs and lows. Everything really began about four months ago after I took on the new regional account.
Can you confirm if this is a single episode with both manic and depressive symptoms occurring together, or have you had separate episodes of mania and depression?

Yes, I can confirm it's been a single, continuous episode where both the high-energy and depressive symptoms are happening together. I haven't had separate, distinct periods of just one or just the other—they have been completely mixed together this whole time.

To clarify, you're saying that this entire experience, with both high-energy and depressive symptoms intermixed, has been one continuous episode since it started after your promotion, without any clear breaks or periods where you returned to a completely normal state in between?

Yes, exactly, it has been one continuous, exhausting cycle without any breaks since about a month after my promotion. I haven't had a single moment of feeling back to my normal self; it's just been a non-stop mix of being extremely wired while simultaneously crashing into those heavy, guilty feelings.
Just to confirm, you've had no periods where you felt completely back to normal, without either the high-energy or depressive symptoms, since this episode started after your promotion?

Yes, that's correct, I haven't had any normal periods at all since this started. It has just been a continuous cycle of either being extremely wired and high-energy, or crashing into those heavy, guilty, depressed feelings over the last four months, with no break in between to feel like my usual self.

Can you confirm if you have experienced any periods of at least two weeks where you had abnormally elevated or irritable mood, persisting for most of the day, and at least three other symptoms such as inflated self-esteem, decreased need for sleep, more talkative, flight of ideas, distractibility, increase in goal-directed activity, or excessive involvement in pleasurable activities, without any depressive symptoms?

I have definitely experienced those high, irritable moods along with racing thoughts, lack of sleep, talking fast, distractibility, and non-stop projects over these last few months. However, it hasn't been without depressive symptoms, because the heavy, guilty, exhausted feelings and dark thoughts of not wanting to wake up have been hanging over me and mixing in during this same period.

Can you describe the longest period where you had a predominantly elevated, expansive, or irritable mood without significant depressive symptoms, and how that compared to the mixed episodes you've been experiencing?

I'm not really sure, because I haven't actually experienced a long period of a purely high or wired mood without those heavy, guilty feelings. Since this all started after my promotion, it has mostly felt like a chaotic mix of being extremely wired and crashing into deep, heavy lows, rather than having a distinct, long period of just being "high" on its own.

Can you estimate the total duration of your current episode, from the start of the high-energy period to the present, and have you experienced any periods within this episode where your mood shifted back to relatively normal for at least two weeks before worsening again?

The entire episode has been going on for about five months, starting roughly a month after my promotion, with the heavy depressive feelings lasting for the last four months of that. I definitely haven't had any normal periods lasting for two weeks during this time; it has just been a continuous cycle of highs and crashes without any real break.

Have you experienced any periods within the last five months where you had a distinct episode of abnormally elevated mood lasting at least four consecutive days, separate from your current mixed episode?

No, I haven't had any separate episodes like that. This is the very first time I've ever experienced these kinds of extreme highs and lows, and it has all been part of one continuous, chaotic period that started after my promotion. There haven't been any separate, distinct phases of just being elevated.

Can you confirm if you have experienced any distinct episodes of elevated mood lasting at least four consecutive days, without depressive symptoms, prior to or separate from your current mixed episode?
I don't recall having any separate, distinct periods of high mood like this prior to my current struggles. This is really the first time I've ever experienced anything this intense.

Can you confirm if your current episode meets the criteria of lasting at least two weeks with a predominant mood of either elevated, expansive, or irritable, and if so, have you experienced any periods within this episode where you had a full remission of symptoms for at least two months?

Yes, my elevated and irritable mood has been going on for several weeks now—really, it's been part of this continuous struggle for about five months, which is way past the two-week mark. I definitely haven't had any periods of full remission or feeling completely back to normal for two months since this whole episode started.

Have you ever experienced a full manic episode, which is a distinct period of abnormally elevated or irritable mood lasting at least one week, where you needed less sleep, had more energy, and possibly engaged in risky behaviors, separate from your current mixed episode?

No, I have never had a separate episode like that in the past. This is the very first time I've ever experienced these extreme highs, intense energy, and lack of sleep, and it all started after my promotion a few months ago.

Have you experienced any distinct periods of at least two weeks where your mood was predominantly elevated or irritable without any significant depressive symptoms, separate from your current episode?

No, this is the very first time I have ever experienced an episode like this. Prior to my recent promotion and these current difficulties, I never had any distinct, weeks-long periods of feeling extremely elevated, wired, or irritable.

Can you confirm if you have had any periods where your symptoms significantly improved for at least two months before worsening again, or has this been a continuous episode without any substantial remission since it started?

Yes, I can confirm this has been one continuous episode without any periods of improvement or remission since it first started about a month after I took on the new regional account. All of these symptoms—the extreme highs and the crashy, guilty lows—have been ongoing and worsening, with the heavy, depressed feelings persisting continuously for the last four months.

Have you experienced any periods where the high-energy symptoms significantly outweighed the depressive symptoms for at least a week, or has the mix of both been relatively consistent throughout the episode?

It’s really felt like a chaotic mix the entire time rather than clean, separate phases. The extreme highs and crashy, guilty lows have been going on together since about a month after my promotion, with the heavy depressive feelings being prominent for the last four months. I often flip on a dime between feeling insanely pumped and snapping or crashing, rather than having a clear week where only the high-energy symptoms existed without any of the low, guilty feelings.
